strings.en:
{1c:10}The more a Trap Capsule is improved,
the more powerful the traps it can use.{1a}I would like to do it free of charge, but
it turns out to cost a fair bit...{1a}so I ask everyone for only the necessary
expenses.{1a}It may sound like an excuse, but allow me
to explain why it costs money.{1a}The Trap Capsules you all carry certainly
look alike, but no two in this world have
the same properties,{1a}and even a Trap Capsule holding a trap
with an effect similar to
{10}-san's{1a}has entirely different workings inside. In
other words, the same improvement
procedure will not work on both.{1a}And development and modification,
though one phrase, mean improving what
is inside the Trap Capsule... that is, the
trap itself,{1a}and developing the Trap Capsule that
holds it. Both must be done.{1a}Each Trap Capsule has its own
character, and each capsule and trap
have their own affinity,{1a}so it takes repeated trial and error.
That is why it costs money.{1a}However, once developed, that trap can
be used as often as you like, thousands
of times over. I believe it is by no means
an expensive investment.

In other words, the same improvement procedure will not work on both. // And development and modification, though one phrase, mean improving what is inside the Trap Capsule... that is, the trap itself, // and developing the Trap Capsule that holds it. Both must be done. // Each Trap Capsule has its own character, and each capsule and trap have their own affinity, // so it takes repeated trial and error. That is why it costs money. // However, once developed, that trap can be used as often as you like, thousands of times over. I believe it is by no means an expensive investment.

strings.en:
{1c:10}To cast 'magic' you need two
implements: a 'Magic Tool' in the shape
of a staff or tablet, and a 'Spell Device',
a bracelet engraved with a sigil.{1a}With these two equipped, you take your
image of that magic, such as the sight
of a flame flying,{1a}and by sending it to the 'Magic Tool' as a
powerful thought-form, you give the
magic substance.{1a}The 'Spell Device' is like a key for
handling the 'Magic Tool', and each spell
you cast needs its own sigil.{1a}Every 'Spell Device' at first shows only
one sigil on its surface, but in truth
several sigils lie hidden.{1a}The work we will now do is to restore
those sigils.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}伝説の国『太陽帝国』の
首都アスラ・ファエル・・・{1a}この遺跡が見つかったのは、
今から約40年前のことでした。
しかし、未だにこの地下都市の
全貌は見えてきません。{1a}地下遺跡の構造、何で出来ているのか、
何のためにつくられたのか、
その当時の生活や文化、技術水準、{1a}私達より優れた技術を持つ
太陽帝国が何故滅んだのか・・・
情けない話ですが、あまりにも
わからないことが多すぎます。{1a}世界にはアスラ・ファエル以外にも、
地下都市の遺構が幾つか存在しますが、
どれも洞窟に毛の生えたような
小規模なものでしかありません。{1a}しかもその大半が、侵略者から
逃げるための避難所のようなもので、{1a}『太陽帝国』という他を圧倒する
軍事力をもつ大帝国が、
そのような避難所を
必要とするかは疑問です。{1a}また、あのような
広大な空間がありながら、
地下都市には人の生活の形跡が
全くありません。{1a}地下都市全体が、神々を祀るための
巨大な地下神殿であったとか、{1a}天変地異から民を守るための
シェルターであったとか、
いろいろな推測が可能ですが、
真実はまだわかりません。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}Asla Fael, capital of the legendary
nation, the 'Sun Empire'...{1a}These ruins were found some forty
years ago. Yet even now, the whole of
this underground city has not come into
view.{1a}The structure of the underground ruins,
what they are made of, what they were
built for, the life, culture and level of
technology of that age,{1a}and why the Sun Empire, whose
technology surpassed our own, perished...
It is a sorry thing to admit, but there is
far too much we do not know.{1a}The world holds a few other remains of
underground cities besides Asla Fael, but
all are small, little more than glorified
caves.{1a}Most of them, moreover, are shelters of
a kind for fleeing invaders,{1a}and it is doubtful that a great empire
like the 'Sun Empire', with its
overwhelming military might, would need
such shelters.{1a}Furthermore, for all its vast space, the
underground city shows no trace
whatever of human life.{1a}One can suppose many things: that the
entire underground city was a huge
underground temple to the gods,{1a}or a shelter to protect the people from
cataclysms. But the truth is still
unknown.{0c:040e}

Yet even now, the whole of this underground city has not come into view. // The structure of the underground ruins, what they are made of, what they were built for, the life, culture and level of technology of that age, // and why the Sun Empire, whose technology surpassed our own, perished... It is a sorry thing to admit, but there is far too much we do not know. // The world holds a few other remains of underground cities besides Asla Fael, but all are small, little more than glorified caves. // Most of them, moreover, are shelters of a kind for fleeing invaders, // and it is doubtful that a great empire like the 'Sun Empire', with its overwhelming military might, would need such shelters. // Furthermore, for all its vast space, the underground city shows no trace whatever of human life. // One can suppose many things: that the entire underground city was a huge underground temple to the gods, // or a shelter to protect the people from cataclysms. But the truth is still unknown.

{1c:10}今より遙か昔、
人々が戦乱に明け暮れていた時代、{1a}突如この世界に現れ繁栄し、
そして忽然と消えたと
伝えられている大帝国・・・{1a}首都は、永遠の都市という意味を持つ
大都市『{03}アスラ・ファエル』・・・{1a}他{02}を圧する高度な
物資文明と精神文明を持ち、
十数年で世界の半分を支配し、{1a}首都{03}アスラ・ファエル{02}の繁栄ぶりは、
天上界の神々が
妬むほどであった・・・{1a}・・・とまあ、このように
伝えられていましたが、{1a}半世紀前まで、この国が実際に
存在していたと信じる学者は
{01}1人{02}もいませんでした。{1a}なにしろ、過去、この国の遺跡が
見つかったことは{01}1度{02}もなく、
太陽帝国に関する伝承の内容も
余りにも荒唐無稽であったからです。{1a}『太陽帝国』の名も
後世の人々が付けた名前で、
文献にその名前が見つかるのは
聖書が書かれたのとほぼ同時期です。{1a}ようするに、神話にありがちな
架空の国と思われていたわけですね。{1a}しかし、{03}アノイア暦{01}5060年{02}、
永遠の命をもたらす『{03}アザレ{02}の石』と、
巨大な地下都市の入り口の発見で
その認識も一変させられます。{1a}しかも、『魔法』『不老不死』
『巨大な地下遺跡』といった
現代の科学力では解析すら不可能な
高度な技術を、{1a}{01}1万年{02}も昔の人々が実現して
いたのです。この事実は、
私達を驚愕させるに充分でした。{1a}多くの研究者が町の内外で
この遺跡を研究してきましたが、
太陽帝国の全貌はまだ{01}1割{02}も
解明されていないでしょう。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}Long, long ago, in an age when people
were lost in endless war,{1a}a great empire, so it is told, suddenly
appeared in this world, flourished, and
just as suddenly vanished...{1a}Its capital was the great city of 'Asla
Fael', a name meaning Eternal City...{1a}Possessing a material and spiritual
civilization advanced beyond all others, it
ruled half the world within little more
than a decade,{1a}and the prosperity of its capital Asla
Fael was such that the gods of the
heavens envied it...{1a}...Or so it was told,{1a}but until half a century ago, not a single
scholar believed this nation had actually
existed.{1a}After all, no ruin of this nation had ever
been found, and the traditions about the
Sun Empire were far too absurd.{1a}Even the name 'Sun Empire' was given by
later generations, and it first appears in
writings at about the time the
Scriptures were written.{1a}In short, it was thought a fictional
nation of the sort common in myth.{1a}However, in Anoian year 5060, the
discovery of the 'Azare Stone', bringer
of eternal life, and of the entrance to a
huge underground city changed that{1a}view at a stroke.{1a}What is more, 'magic', 'agelessness and
undying life', 'vast underground ruins',
advanced techniques that today's
science cannot even analyze,{1a}were achieved by people ten thousand
years ago. That fact was enough to
astonish us.{1a}Many researchers have studied these
ruins, in town and out, but not even a
tenth of the Sun Empire has yet been
made clear, I should think.{0c:040e}

彼等はいったい何者なのかなど、
不明な点だらけです。{1a}とはいえ『分かりません』で
話を終わらせてしまうのも
申し訳ありませんので、{1a}私以外の科学者や神学者の説を
幾つか紹介しましょう。{1a}まず{01}1{02}つ目、
魔物達は最下層にある
なにか特別な物を守っている番人の
ようなものであるという説・・・{1a}学者のみならず、
この町の冒険者の多くが
この説を信じていますね。{1a}遺跡内は、奥深くに進めば進むほど
出現する魔物は強くなっていきます。
見つかる財宝もそれに比例して
立派なものになっていきますので、{1a}最下層にはよほど凄い財宝が
あるのだろうと、
多くの冒険者が期待しているのも
無理からぬことです。{1a}次に、自らの繁栄におごり
神をないがしろにした
太陽帝国の人々が、神の怒りをかい
魔物に姿を変えられたという説・・・{1a}反教皇派の神学者や司教・・・
つまり生真面目な聖衣の方々は
この説を推しています。{1a}{01}3{02}つ目、永遠の生命を追い求めた
太陽帝国の人々が、
実験に失敗しあのような姿に
なってしまったという説・・・{1a}他には、{01}1万年前{02}、
魔物達は遺跡の中だけでなく、
世界各地にいたのだという

strings.en:
{1c:10}As for the monsters, too, where they
came from, why they suddenly appeared
in the underground ruins, what on earth
they are: nearly all of it is unknown.{1a}Still, it would be rude to end the talk at
'I do not know',{1a}so let me present a few theories from
other scientists and theologians.{1a}First, the theory that the monsters are
guardians of a sort, protecting
something special on the lowest level...{1a}Not only scholars but many of this
town's adventurers believe this theory.{1a}The deeper one goes in the ruins, the
stronger the monsters that appear. The
treasure found grows finer in
proportion,{1a}so it is no wonder that many
adventurers hope for some truly
marvelous treasure on the lowest level.{1a}Next, the theory that the people of the
Sun Empire, proud of their prosperity
and slighting God, drew God's wrath and
were turned into monsters...{1a}Anti-papal theologians and bishops... that
is, the earnest gentlemen of the holy
vestments, favor this theory.{1a}Third, the theory that the people of the
Sun Empire, in pursuit of eternal life,
failed in an experiment and took on
those forms...{1a}There is also a theory that ten
thousand years ago, monsters lived not
only in the ruins but all over the world.{1a}That the myths and legends told in
various lands were created with those
monsters as models.{1a}Indeed, in the myths and legends of the
world one can find many descriptions of
creatures closely resembling the
monsters of Asla Fael.{1a}It seems correct at first glance, but
among the monsters of the underground
ruins are a few kinds closely resembling
creatures invented in a children's fable{1a}only fifty years ago,{1a}creatures whose author is clearly known,
so this theory leaves some doubt.{1a}To sum up, the answer is still 'I have not
the faintest idea', after all.{0c:040e}

strings.jp:
{1c:10}『{03}アザレ{02}の石』・・・
この石の光を浴びた人間は
不老不死となり、{1a}いかなる病気や怪我でも、
たとえ心臓に剣を突き立てられても
死なない人間となります。{1a}赤く熱した鉄で体を傷つけても
次の日には傷跡{01}1{02}つ残らない・・・
これが、本当に幸せなことか
どうかはわかりません。{1a}ともかく、今から約{01}40年前{02}、
偶然この石を見つけた{03}アオゥル族{02}の
{01}13人{02}は、この石の放つ光を浴び
不老不死となりました。{1a}そして、永遠の命を得たいがために、
{03}アスロイト王国{02}と
{03}バイレステ共和国{02}の指導者達は
この地下遺跡の発掘を始めました。{1a}そう、すべての始まりは
『{03}アザレ{02}の石』だったのです。{1a}しかしそれ以降、
この『{03}アザレ{02}の石』は
{01}1度{02}も発見されていません。{1a}最初の『{03}アザレ{02}の石』も、
{03}アオゥル族{02}の人々を不死にすると、
役目を終えたのか、光を失い
ただの石ころに変わったそうです。{1a}私も、自分の目で
実際に見たことはありませんので、
『{03}アザレ{02}の石』とは一体何なのか、
どういった物なのかはわかりません。{1a}『太陽帝国』が永遠の世界を
追い求めていたことは
ほぼ間違いないでしょう。{1a}しかし、その技術が完成して
生まれたのが『{03}アザレ{02}の石』ならば、
なぜ、地下遺跡に不死となった人が
{01}1人{02}もいないのか・・・{1a}疑問は尽きません。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}The 'Azare Stone'... Any person bathed in
this stone's light becomes ageless and
undying,{1a}a person who will not die of any sickness
or wound, not even a sword driven
through the heart.{1a}Cut the body with red-hot iron, and by
the next day not a scar remains...
Whether this is truly happiness, I cannot
say.{1a}In any event, some forty years ago,
thirteen of the Aoul tribe who found
this stone by chance were bathed in its
light and became ageless and undying.{1a}Then, wishing to gain eternal life, the
leaders of the Kingdom of Asroit and
the Republic of Baileste began
excavating these underground ruins.{1a}Yes, it all began with the 'Azare Stone'.{1a}But since then, no 'Azare Stone' has
ever been found.{1a}Even the first 'Azare Stone', once it had
made the Aoul people undying, lost its
light, its role perhaps fulfilled, and
turned into a mere pebble, they say.{1a}I have never seen one with my own eyes,
so I cannot tell you what an 'Azare
Stone' truly is, or what sort of thing.{1a}It is all but certain that the 'Sun Empire'
was pursuing the Eternal World.{1a}But if the 'Azare Stone' is what came
of perfecting that technique, why is
there not a single person made undying in
the underground ruins...{1a}The questions never end.{0c:040e}

{1c:10}『アザレの石』の所在については
有力な説が2つあります。{1a}最も広く信じられている説は、
地下遺跡の1番奥に
あるという説でしょう。{1a}この説は、地下遺跡の中で見つけた
幾つかの石版や壁画に、{1a}『世界の底に永遠の源あり』という
一節が彫られていたことから
導き出された仮説です。{1a}ただし、地下遺跡の終点がどこなのか
誰も知りませんので、
この説の真偽を確かめる方法は
今のところありません。{1a}もう1つの説が、
地下都市アスラ・ファエルの何処かに
あるという説です。{1a}地下都市の主要な建物の壁には、
『永遠』や『輪廻』を意味する
言葉やデザインが
幾つも彫られていますし、{1a}『アザレの石』と同時に
発見された装飾品が、
現在地下都市内で発見されている
装飾品と同じだという噂もあります。{1a}ただし、こちらの方も真偽のほどは
分かりません。{1a}『アザレの石』と共に発見された
装飾品は、アスロイト王宮の宝物庫に
あるので、私のような一介の学者が
見ることは出来ませんし、{1a}なにより、地下都市の4割近くが
調査済みにもかかわらず
何の痕跡も見つかっていないという
現状もあります。{1a}アノイア暦5060年の大地震と共に
地上世界にひょっこりあらわれた
『アザレの石』・・・{1a}遺跡の1番奥にせよ地下都市にせよ、
はるか地中にある物が
いきなり地上に出てくるのも
考えてみれば不思議な話です。{1a}もしかすると
全く別の所にあるのかも・・・
疑問は尽きません。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}There are two leading theories as to the
whereabouts of the 'Azare Stone'.{1a}The most widely believed is that it lies at
the very deepest point of the
underground ruins.{1a}This theory was drawn from several
tablets and murals found in the
underground ruins,{1a}on which is carved the passage 'At the
floor of the world lies the wellspring of
eternity.'{1a}However, since no one knows where the
underground ruins end, there is at
present no way to test its truth.{1a}The other theory is that it lies
somewhere in the underground city of
Asla Fael.{1a}On the walls of the city's principal
buildings are carved many words and
designs signifying 'eternity' and
'reincarnation',{1a}and there is also a rumor that the
ornaments discovered along with the
'Azare Stone' match those now being
found in the underground city.{1a}Here too, however, the truth is unknown.{1a}The ornaments discovered with the
'Azare Stone' are in the treasury of the
royal palace of Asroit, where a mere
scholar such as myself cannot see{1a}them,{1a}and above all, there is the fact that
nearly 40 percent of the underground
city has been surveyed without a trace
being found.{1a}The 'Azare Stone' simply turned up on
the surface, along with the great
earthquake of Anoian year 5060...{1a}Whether it lay at the deepest point of
the ruins or in the underground city, it is
a curious thing, when you think of it, for
something so far underground to come{1a}suddenly to the surface.{1a}Perhaps it lies somewhere else entirely...
The questions never end.{0c:040e}

The questions never end.

{1c:10}『太陽帝国』は、今から1万年ほど前、
アノイア暦前4500年に
繁栄したと考えられています。{1a}それより5百年前のリガレア文明や
2千年後の第一王朝と比べると、
比較にならないほど『太陽帝国』の
科学技術は進んでいる・・・{1a}そこだけを見ると、
『太陽帝国』は突然この世に
現れたかのようにも思えてきます。{1a}一方、文字や宗教の面では、
他の時代の文明との共通性や連続性が
幾つか発見されています。{1a}もっとも、
2百年前の教会建築で
使われ始めた装飾方式、{1a}つまり、近世にしか
その類型が存在しないはずの物も
幾つか発見されているので、
これまた理解に苦しむばかりです。 {1a}もちろん、
他の時代との関連性があるおかげで
私達学者は太陽帝国の文字を
読むことが出来るのですが・・・{0c:040e}

{1c:10}The 'Sun Empire' is thought to have
flourished about ten thousand years
ago, around the year 4500 before the
Anoian calendar.{1a}Set beside the Rigalean civilization five
hundred years earlier or the First
Dynasty two thousand years later, the
science and technology of the 'Sun{1a}Empire' are advanced beyond all

think the 'Sun Empire' had appeared in

exist only in recent times, have also been
found here and there, which leaves us
baffled all over again.{1a}Of course, it is thanks to those ties
with other eras that we scholars can
read the writing of the Sun Empire at
all...{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}The 'Black Passage' runs through the
north face of the wall that encloses the
underground city of Asla Fael like a
dome,{1a}threading it like the mesh of a net, or so

多いのですが、{1a}厳密に言えば

黄金色の地下都市のみを指す名称と
考えた方がいいでしょう。{1a}さて、
『アスラ・ファエル』の1番の謎は、
何といってもその巨大さですね。{1a}初めてアスラ・ファエルに

本当にここが地下の世界なのかと
自分の目を疑うといいます。{1a}そこには、
大小あわせて千を越える
建物が存在しますが、{1a}探索を始めて
40年近くが経過した今でも
私達冒険者の足跡は
まだ半分にも達していないのです。{1a}バルデスさんという
心強い相棒のいる私でさえ、
この6年間に訪れた場所は
全体の2割にも達していません。{1a}ちなみに、皆さんが探さなければ
ならない『太陽の宝玉』は、{1a}アスラ・ファエルの城門に隣接した
『第一神殿』という名の建物の
最上階の広間にあります。{1a}城門から1番近い建物とはいえ、

広間までは、『黒の羨道』の全長に
匹敵する距離があります。{1a}心してかかって下さい。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}The name 'Asla Fael' is more often used
for the ruins as a whole, including the
'Black Passage', 'Purgatory' and so on,{1a}but strictly speaking, it is better
thought of as the name of the golden
underground city alone, the capital of
the 'Sun Empire'.{1a}Now, the greatest mystery of 'Asla
Fael' is, above all, its sheer size.{1a}Everyone who first sets foot in Asla
Fael, they say, doubts their own eyes:
can this truly be a world underground?{1a}More than a thousand buildings, great
and small, stand there,{1a}yet even now, nearly 40 years after
exploration began, the footprints of us
adventurers do not reach even half of
them.{1a}Even I, with so reliable a partner as
Valdes-san, have visited less than 20
percent of it in these six years.{1a}Incidentally, as for the 'Sun Jewel' that
you all must find,{1a}it lies in the hall on the top floor of a
building called the 'First Temple', which
adjoins the city gate of Asla Fael.{1a}It may be the building nearest the gate,
but the distance from the gate to the
hall with the 'Sun Jewel' matches the full
length of the 'Black Passage'.{1a}Please be on your guard.{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}Searing rivers of lava, bare and jagged
rock, heat so fierce it is hard to
breathe...{1a}Scenery just like the 'Purgatory' painted
in the Scriptures spreads out beneath
the underground city of Asla Fael.{1a}Even the name 'Purgatory', I am told,
came naturally into use among those who
visited the place, with no one person
coining it.{1a}That is how closely it resembles the
Scriptures' description.{1a}Although the treasures to be had there
are often more valuable than those of
'Asla Fael',{1a}the people of this town seldom set foot
in 'Purgatory'.{1a}In both danger and efficiency,
'Purgatory' keeps adventurers at a
distance,{1a}but there is also a matter of the mind:
the name 'Purgatory' and its scenery call
to mind the world of the dead painted in
the Scriptures.{1a}Incidentally, 'Purgatory' in the Scriptures
lies between the Celestial Realm and Hell,{1a}and is held to be the place where the
souls of the dead have their sins purged
by fire before entering the Celestial
Realm.{1a}The real 'Purgatory', that is, the one in
the Scriptures, can be entered only by
dying, but the 'Purgatory' beneath our
feet{1a}you may reach simply by going down one
of the many stairways in the
underground city. Of course, it would be
wise to stay out of it for the time{1a}being.{0c:040e}

Of course, it would be wise to stay out of it for the time being.

氷のように冷たいうち捨てられた
神殿の跡があります。{1a}現在確認されている各層の中で
最も奥深くにあるこの遺跡を、
私達は『時の回廊』と呼んでいます。{1a}遺跡で発見された壁画や石版には、
さらに奥に『永遠の世界』が
存在すると書かれていますが、
真偽を確かめる方法はありません。{1a}理由は簡単、
時の回廊は数階層で行き止まりと
なっているからです。{1a}『時の回廊』という名称も
『煉獄』と同じく、

二大神ゼメンとゼウェアクが
古の神々を、それを祀る神殿と共に
封印した場所であるとされています。{1a}もっともこのお話よりは、

封印された古の神々に生け贄に捧げた
罪深き男の説話の方が有名ですね。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}Delve further below Purgatory and you
find the remains of an abandoned temple,
cold as ice.{1a}This site, the deepest of all the levels
confirmed so far, we call the 'Corridor
of Time'.{1a}Murals and tablets found in the ruins say
that an 'Eternal World' lies deeper still,
but there is no way to test the truth
of this.{1a}The reason is simple: the Corridor of
Time comes to a dead end after a few
levels.{1a}The name 'Corridor of Time', like
'Purgatory', was taken from the
Scriptures.{1a}The 'Corridor of Time' in the Scriptures
is held to be the place where the Two
Supreme Gods Zemen and Zeweak sealed
away the ancient gods, together with{1a}the temples that enshrined them.{1a}Better known than this account,
however, is the tale of the sinful man
who sacrificed his own friend to the
sealed ancient gods to gain eternal life.{0c:040e}

{1c:10}『魔法』を詠唱するには
杖や石版の形をした『魔法具』と、
刻印のきざまれた腕輪『魔法操具』
という2つの道具が必要です。{1a}この2つを装備し、
炎が相手を燃やし尽くすなどの
イメージを、『思念』として
『魔法具』に送ることで{1a}心の中のイメージが具現化され、
魔法が発射されます。{1a}『魔法操具』は、『魔法具』を
扱うための鍵のようなもので、
唱える魔法ごとに
別の刻印が必要となります。{1a}この鍵と、頭に描いた魔法の
イメージがピタリと一致した時のみ
魔法が具現化されるわけですね。{1a}どの『魔法操具』も
初めは1つの刻印しか
表面にあらわれていませんが、{1a}実際には必ず数種類の刻印が

strings.en:
{1c:10}To cast 'magic', one needs two
implements: a 'Magic Tool' in the form of
a staff or tablet, and a 'Spell Device', a
bracelet engraved with a sigil.{1a}When you equip these two and send an
image, such as flames burning an enemy
to nothing, into the 'Magic Tool' as a
'thought-form',{1a}the image in your mind takes shape, and
the magic is released.{1a}The 'Spell Device' is a kind of key for
handling the 'Magic Tool', and each spell
cast requires a different sigil.{1a}Only when this key and the image of the
magic in your mind match exactly does
the magic take shape.{1a}Every 'Spell Device' shows only one sigil
on its surface at first,{1a}but in truth, several kinds of sigil are
always hidden within it.{1a}Last year I completed a prototype of a
device that forcibly brings those sigils to
the surface.{1a}Its stability is still low, so it cannot raise
the sigil of a powerful spell right away,{1a}but when you wish to add to your magic,
please do consult me.{1a}However, a 'Spell Device' with restored
sigils carries certain restrictions: it
cannot be passed to anyone else,{1a}once you have taken one up you can
never hold another Spell Device,{1a}and it cancels the effect of Trap
Capsules, so those who fight with
weapons effectively cannot use it.{1a}As for the 'Magic Tool', you may switch
to another, but doing so does not
change the kinds of magic you have.{1a}It can, however, raise the power of the
magic itself, so finding a fine Magic Tool
is also an important part of a wizard's
work.{1a}That is everything now known about the
workings of magic.{0c:f702a6040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}Inside a small capsule that fits in the
palm of your hand are two lines of
devices useful in battle against
monsters.{1a}By modifying a Trap Capsule, you can
also use more powerful traps.{1a}I would like to do this free of charge,
but it turns out to be rather costly...{1a}so I ask you only for the necessary
expenses.{1a}It may sound like an excuse, but let me
at least tell you why it costs money.{1a}The Trap Capsules you carry may all look
alike, but no two in this world have the
same properties.{1a}For example, even if another Trap
Capsule holds traps with effects much
like those in {10}-san's,{1a}the mechanism inside is different in each
and every one. In other words, the same
steps of improvement will not carry over.{1a}And though we speak simply of
development and modification, there is
the contents of the Trap Capsule... that
is, improving the trap itself,{1a}and developing the Trap Capsule that
houses it, and both must be done.{1a}Each Trap Capsule has its own
character, and capsules and traps each
have their own affinities,{1a}so it takes trial and error, over and
over. That is why it costs money.{1a}However, once a trap is developed, it is
yours to use as you like, thousands of
times over. I believe it is by no means an
expensive investment.{0c:f7028d040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}The name 'Asla Fael' is more often used
for the ruins as a whole, including the
'Black Passage', 'Purgatory' and so on,{1a}but strictly speaking, it is better
thought of as the name of the golden
underground city alone, the capital of
the 'Sun Empire'.{1a}Now, the greatest mystery of 'Asla
Fael' is, above all, its sheer size.{1a}Look up at the sky and there is a sun
that never sets, and clouds drifting by...{1a}However many times I go there, I nearly
forget that it is a world deep under the
earth.{1a}More than a thousand buildings, great
and small, stand there,{1a}yet even now, nearly 40 years after
exploration began, the footprints of us
adventurers do not reach even half of
them.{1a}Even I, with so reliable a partner as
Valdes-san, have visited less than 20
percent of it in six years.{1a}Incidentally, the 'Sun Jewel' that you all
must find lies in the hall on the top floor
of the 'First Temple'.{1a}It may be a single building, but the
distance from the gate to the hall with
the 'Sun Jewel' matches the full length
of the 'Black Passage'.{1a}Please do be on your guard.{0c:040e}

strings.jp:
{1c:12}アスラ・ファエルは
精神世界の集合体であり、
そこでは人々の様々な感情が
具現化・物質化する・・・{1a}そして、精神世界と物質世界は
今まさに融合しつつあり、
やがては全ての境界が消え去り
形のない1つの『意志』になる・・・{1a}そして、それこそが
太陽帝国の人々が追い求めた
『永遠の世界』の正体なのでは
ないか・・・{1a}これが、私の導き出した
地下遺跡の謎への回答です。{1a}といっても、
自分の導き出したこの結論によって
余計に謎が深まった部分の方が
多いかもしれませんね。{1a}最大の疑問は、『もしアノイア教が
存在しなかったら』ということです。{1a}太陽帝国の人々が、
アノイア教の教義における
『新しい世界』とほとんど同じ形の
『永遠の世界』を追い求めていたのは{1a}地上世界に残る様々な文献から考えて
ほぼ間違いないと確信しています。{1a}ですが、もしアノイア教が
5千年前に誕生しなかったら、{1a}『新しい世界』を求める感情が
人々の心に芽生えることなど
なかったわけですし、{1a}物質世界と精神世界の融合や、
魔物の出現でさえも
起こらなかったかもしれません。{1a}もしアノイア教が存在したとしても、
『新しい世界』という教義がなければ
別の結果になっていたでしょうし、{1a}アノイア教が
ただの地方宗教で終わっていても
違う結果になっていたでしょう。{1a}さすがにそんなことはないでしょうが、
もし偶然の未来に賭けたのであれば、
太陽帝国の計画はあまりにもお粗末と
言わざるをえないでしょうね。{1a}1万年前に滅んだはずの太陽帝国が
どうやって5千年後の
アノイア教の誕生と隆盛を
ここまで正確に予測したのか・・・{1a}これが最大の疑問です。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}Asla Fael is an aggregate of spirit
worlds, where people's many emotions
take form and become matter...{1a}And the spirit world and the material
world are even now fusing; in time all
boundaries will vanish, and they will
become one formless 'Will'...{1a}And might that not be the true nature
of the 'Eternal World' that the people of
the Sun Empire pursued...{1a}That is the answer I have drawn to the
riddle of the underground ruins.{1a}That said, this conclusion of mine may
well have deepened more mysteries than
it solved.{1a}The greatest question is: 'What if the
Anoian faith had never existed?'{1a}That the people of the Sun Empire
pursued an 'Eternal World' almost
identical in form to the 'New World' of
Anoian doctrine{1a}I hold to be all but certain, judging from
the many texts that survive in the
surface world.{1a}Yet had the Anoian faith not been born
five thousand years ago,{1a}the longing for a 'New World' would never
have sprung up in people's hearts,{1a}and the fusion of the material world and
the spirit world, even the appearance of
monsters, might never have happened.{1a}Even had the Anoian faith existed,
without the doctrine of the 'New World'
the result would surely have been
different,{1a}and had the Anoian faith ended as a
mere local religion, the result would
likewise have been different.{1a}Surely it cannot be so, but if they were
gambling on a chance future, then the
plan of the Sun Empire must be called
shoddy in the extreme.{1a}How could the Sun Empire, which should
have fallen ten thousand years ago,
foresee so exactly the birth and rise of
the Anoian faith five thousand years{1a}later...{1a}That is the greatest question.{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}Asla Fael is an aggregate of spirit
worlds, where people's many emotions
take form and become matter...{1a}That vast underground city too, I
believe, was born of our image of the
Sun Empire.{1a}This does not mean, however, that no
country called the Sun Empire ever
existed.{1a}The name of the Sun Empire first
appears in books about five thousand
years ago,{1a}but myths and traditions of a similar
country, under other names, existed
before then,{1a}and above all, had the people of the Sun
Empire not built the 'mechanism that
gives form to the human spirit',{1a}that vast underground city would never
have been born.{1a}The formal name of the country ten
thousand years ago may not have been
the Sun Empire. And it may have stood
not ten thousand years ago but far{1a}earlier, or far later.{1a}But this much alone is surely beyond
doubt: a people raised a civilization of
rare sophistication in the Kars
Mountains.{0c:040e}

worlds, where people's many emotions

between Heaven and Hell,{1a}and is held to be the place where the

birth of the Anoian faith.{0c:040e}

strings.jp:
{1c:10}地下遺跡の1番奥にあると
考えられている『始原の地』・・・{1a}しかし、誰も実際にその目で
見たことはありませんので、
代わりに聖書の文章を
幾つか紹介しましょう。{1a}まず、聖書の冒頭・・・
天地創造の章には
このように書かれています。{1a}『無よりゼメンとゼウェアク別れる。
其の地を始原の地という。
始原の地より七つの世界生まれる。
神、その外に十三の人をつくれり。』{1a}これは、始原の地とは
二大神ゼメンとゼウェアクが
2つに別れた地、{1a}そして、7つの世界が誕生する
天地創造の始まりの地であることを
意味する文章ですね。{1a}それ以前の世界は、
二大神すらも存在しない
『無』の世界であったとされています。{1a}そして、聖書の巻末・・・
黙示録の章にはこう書かれています。{1a}『人々の神を求める声が高まり、
復讐と怒りを司る忌まわしき魔物が
天界の神殿を血で汚した時、
第二の預言者あらわれる・・・{1a}そして、第二の預言者が
『始原の地』への光の扉を開いた時
人の時代は終わり、{1a}永遠なる神の時代
『新しい世界』が始まる・・・』{1a}これが、
いわゆる第二の天地創造ですね。{1a}今私達がいるこの世界はなくなり、
肉体と霊魂の境界のない
永遠なる神の国が創られる・・・{1a}二大神は再び1つに戻り、
そこに人々の肉体と霊魂が融合し、
『完全なる1つのもの』になる・・・{1a}その国の住人は、『永遠の命』と
『神と共なる至福の生活』を
手に入れることが出来る・・・
そう聖書には書かれています。{1a}私達人間も、
二大神ゼメンとゼウェアクも、
全てが1つに融合する
完璧な世界の誕生・・・{1a}特にこのくだりは、
どの教派であっても
礼拝のたびに必ず口にする
聖書でも最も重要かつ有名な一節です。{1a}そして、精神を具現化する
アスラ・ファエルという装置が、
地上世界と融合しているのであれば、{1a}この有名な一節が現実のものに
なっても何ら不思議ではない・・・{1a}事実、
黙示録の章に書かれてあることの
幾つかは既に現実のものと
なっているのですから。{1a}これを阻止するには、
『始原の地』を封印する・・・{1a}つまり『始原の地』への
唯一の入り口である『光の扉』が
開くのを阻止するしかないのではと
私は考えています。{1a}といっても、この根拠さえ
聖書や遺跡で発見された碑文から
導き出したのですから、{1a}必ず成功する、絶対に正しいとは
言い難いのですが・・・{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:10}The 'Land of Origin', thought to lie at
the very deepest point of the
underground ruins...{1a}However, no one has actually seen it
with their own eyes, so instead, let me
introduce a few passages from the
Scriptures.{1a}First, the opening of the Scriptures...
The chapter of Creation says this.{1a}'From the Void, Zemen and Zeweak
parted. That land is called the Land of
Origin. From the Land of Origin were the
seven worlds born. And God made{1a}thirteen men outside them.'{1a}This passage means that the Land of
Origin is the land where the Two
Supreme Gods Zemen and Zeweak parted
in two,{1a}and the land where Creation began, with
the birth of the seven worlds.{1a}What came before is held to have been a
world of 'Void', where not even the Two
Supreme Gods existed.{1a}And the end of the Scriptures... The
chapter of Revelation says this.{1a}'When the voices of the people crying
out for God swell, and a hateful monster
ruling vengeance and wrath stains the
temple of the Celestial Realm with{1a}blood, the second Prophet shall appear...{1a}And when the second Prophet opens the
door of light to the 'Land of Origin', the
age of man shall end,{1a}and the eternal age of God, the 'New
World', shall begin...'{1a}This is the so-called second Creation.{1a}This world we now live in will be no more,
and an eternal kingdom of God with no
boundary between flesh and soul will be
made...{1a}The Two Supreme Gods will return to
one, and people's flesh and souls will fuse
with them into 'one perfect whole'...{1a}The dwellers of that kingdom will gain
'eternal life' and 'a life of bliss with
God'... So the Scriptures say.{1a}We humans and the Two Supreme Gods
Zemen and Zeweak all fusing into one,
the birth of a perfect world...{1a}This part above all is the most important
and famous passage of the Scriptures,
spoken at every service in every
denomination.{1a}And if Asla Fael, a device that gives
form to the spirit, is fusing with the
surface world,{1a}it would be no wonder at all if this
famous passage came true...{1a}In fact, several things written in the
chapter of Revelation have already come
true.{1a}To stop this, we must seal the 'Land of
Origin'...{1a}In other words, I believe the only way
may be to keep the 'Door of Light', the
one entrance to the 'Land of Origin',
from opening.{1a}That said, even these grounds I drew
from the Scriptures and from
inscriptions found in the ruins,{1a}so I can hardly say it is certain to
succeed, or absolutely right...{0c:040e}

And God made thirteen men outside them.' // This passage means that the Land of Origin is the land where the Two Supreme Gods Zemen and Zeweak parted in two, // and the land where Creation began, with the birth of the seven worlds. // What came before is held to have been a world of 'Void', where not even the Two Supreme Gods existed. // And the end of the Scriptures... strings.jp:
{1c:12}アスラ・ファエルは
精神世界の集合体であり、
そこでは人々の様々な感情が
具現化・物質化する・・・{1a}魔物の出現に関しては
これでほとんどの謎が解決しました。{1a}遺跡に出現する多くの魔物達は、
人間の恐怖心、猜疑心、
憎悪、嫉妬などの負の感情が
具現化したものなのでしょう。{1a}アノイア教の布教により
悪魔におとしめられた古代の神々や、
出自の明らかな歴史の浅い魔獣が
出現するのもこれで説明がつきます。{1a}そして、天界において、
天使達が具現化したことも
同じ理由で説明出来るでしょう。{1a}ただしこちらは負の感情ではなく、
信仰心という強力な意識に
根ざしたものですから、{1a}今まで以上に困難な戦いになることは
避けられないでしょう・・・{1a}ですが、姿は天使といっても
その目的は他の魔物と変わりません。
姿に騙されず、
本質を見極めて戦って下さい。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}Asla Fael is an aggregate of spirit
worlds, where people's many emotions
take form and become matter...{1a}With this, nearly every mystery about
the appearance of monsters has been
solved.{1a}Most of the monsters that appear in
the ruins are surely the embodied form
of negative human emotions: fear,
suspicion, hatred, jealousy.{1a}It also explains the appearance of
ancient gods reduced to devils by the
spread of the Anoian faith, and of
beasts of recent history and known{1a}origin.{1a}And the angels taking form in the
Celestial Realm can be explained for the
same reason.{1a}These, however, are rooted not in
negative emotions but in the powerful
force of faith,{1a}so a harder battle than any so far will
be unavoidable...{1a}Yet though they have the form of
angels, their purpose is no different
from that of other monsters. Please do
not be fooled by their form; see their{1a}true nature as you fight.{0c:040e}

strings.jp:
{1c:12}第一聖者アヴァダイルは
{10}さん達の前で言いました。{1a}『私達は太陽帝国の子であり、
預言者アノイアの高弟であり、
アオゥルの血族でもある・・・』と。{1a}彼等は1万年も前から
全ての計画を準備していた・・・
となれば、導き出される答は
1つしかないのです。{1a}そう・・・
アノイア教の存在自体、
仕組まれていたものであると
考えるしかありません。{1a}私は今まで
1万年前の太陽帝国の人々が
どうやってここまで正確に
未来を予測したのかが疑問でした。{1a}アノイア教が誕生しなければ、
そしてアノイア教が世界宗教にまで
成長しなければ、{1a}彼等の計画は何ひとつ
実現しないからです。{1a}彼等が偶然の未来に賭けたのであれば
その計画はあまりにもお粗末だと
言うしかない・・・
そう思っていました。{1a}ですが、彼等は
未来を予測したのではなかった・・・
彼等は、自分達に都合のいいように
未来を創っていったのでしょう。{1a}アノイア教の誕生もそうですし、
アノイア教の教義も、
世界宗教にまで成長する道のりも、
全て彼等の仕業だった・・・{1a}魔物の発生も、
地下遺跡の入り口が突然現れたことも、
天使の降臨もそうでしょうし、{1a}もしかすると
千年続いたあの平和な時代さえも、
彼等の登場をより衝撃的にするための
準備期間だったのかもしれない・・・{1a}もちろんこれはまだ仮説ですので、
明確な根拠などはありません。
ですが、これらがすべて
仕組まれていたものなら、{1a}今回の一連の出来事についての
聖書の不自然な描写も、
すべて説明出来るのです。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}The First Saint Avadail said before
{10}-san and the others:{1a}'We are children of the Sun Empire, high
disciples of the Prophet Anoia, and kin
of the Aoul...'{1a}They had been preparing the whole plan
for ten thousand years... If so, only one
answer can be drawn.{1a}Yes... We can only conclude that the very
existence of the Anoian faith was
contrived.{1a}Until now I had wondered how the people
of the Sun Empire, ten thousand years
ago, could foresee the future so
exactly.{1a}For had the Anoian faith not been born,
and had the Anoian faith not grown into
a world religion,{1a}nothing in their plan could have come
about.{1a}If they were gambling on a chance
future, their plan could only be called
shoddy in the extreme... So I thought.{1a}But they did not foresee the future...
They surely made the future, to suit
themselves.{1a}The birth of the Anoian faith, its
doctrine, its road to becoming a world
religion: all of it was their doing...{1a}So too, it seems, the rise of the
monsters, the sudden appearance of the
entrance to the underground ruins, and
the descent of the angels,{1a}and perhaps even that thousand-year
age of peace was but a time of
preparation, to make their arrival the
more shocking...{1a}Of course this is still only a hypothesis,
with no clear evidence. But if all of this
was contrived,{1a}then the Scriptures' unnatural
descriptions of this whole chain of
events can all be explained.{0c:040e}

If so, only one answer can be drawn. // Yes... We can only conclude that the very existence of the Anoian faith was contrived. // Until now I had wondered how the people of the Sun Empire, ten thousand years ago, could foresee the future so exactly. // For had the Anoian faith not been born, and had the Anoian faith not grown into a world religion, // nothing in their plan could have come about. // If they were gambling on a chance future, their plan could only be called shoddy in the extreme... So I thought. // But they did not foresee the future... They surely made the future, to suit themselves. // The birth of the Anoian faith, its doctrine, its road to becoming a world religion: all of it was their doing... // So too, it seems, the rise of the monsters, the sudden appearance of the entrance to the underground ruins, and the descent of the angels, // and perhaps even that thousand-year age of peace was but a time of preparation, to make their arrival the more shocking... // Of course this is still only a hypothesis, with no clear evidence. But if all of this was contrived, // then the Scriptures' unnatural descriptions of this whole chain of events can all be explained.

strings.jp:
{1c:12}十三聖者は自分達のことを
『神ではない』
『神の代弁者にすぎない』と
言いました。{1a}では、神とは何か・・・{1a}彼等は神のことを
『人類全体の意志』
『ひとりひとりの心の働きの源』
『アスラ・ファエルの根源』{1a}そして、『新しい世界』
そのものであると説明しました。{1a}彼等が言うように
人間が神を生み出したのであれば、
十三聖者は人の心を代弁している
ということにもなります。{1a}さらに、十三聖者は自分達のことを
『太陽帝国の子』とも
言いました・・・{1a}話がややこしくなりましたが、
これらの言葉から
太陽帝国とアノイア教が同じ未来を
理想としていたのが証明出来ますね。{1a}私達の心はアノイア教によって
染め上げられているのですから。{1a}ですが、こうなると
今度は別の疑問が浮かびます・・・{1a}第一神殿でお会いした時
お話ししましたが、地下遺跡の中には
明らかにアノイア教的ではない
メッセージも残っているのです。{1a}輪廻転生への恐れもそうですし、
永遠に対する絶望ともとれる内容の
碑文も時折発見されます。{1a}アノイア教と太陽帝国が
同じ方向を向いていたのだとすれば、
永遠に対する絶望などという、{1a}どちらにも当てはまらない内容の
碑文が残っているはずは
ありません・・・{1a}これが一体何を意味するのか・・・
謎は深まるばかりです。{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}The Thirteen Saints said of themselves
that they are 'not gods' and 'no more
than God's spokesmen'.{1a}Then what is God...{1a}They described God as 'the will of all
humankind', 'the source of the working
of each and every heart', 'the root of
Asla Fael',{1a}and the 'New World' itself.{1a}If humankind gave birth to God, as they
say, then the Thirteen Saints are also
speaking for the human heart.{1a}Further, the Thirteen Saints also called
themselves 'children of the Sun Empire'...{1a}This has grown tangled, but these words
prove that the Sun Empire and the
Anoian faith held the same future as
their ideal.{1a}For our hearts have been dyed by the
Anoian faith.{1a}But now another question arises...{1a}As I told you when we met in the First
Temple, the underground ruins also hold
messages that are plainly not Anoian.{1a}There is the dread of reincarnation, and
now and then inscriptions turn up that
could be read as despair at eternity.{1a}If the Anoian faith and the Sun Empire
faced the same way, then inscriptions
speaking of despair at eternity,{1a}which fit neither of them, should not
exist...{1a}What on earth does this mean... The
mystery only deepens.{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}The Second Saint Barkail said it: the
Devil is one who hinders the coming of
the 'New World'.{1a}As I told you before, the one who
hinders the coming of the 'New World'
must indeed be the Devil.{1a}And the Second Saint Barkail said, 'The
Devil too has a role.'{1a}What is that role... To put it bluntly,
might it not be 'to be defeated by God'?{1a}As they say, few religions wholly deny
the existence of the Devil, the
existence of evil.{1a}Even in the doctrine of the Anoian faith,
where the Two Supreme Gods rule all and
no other god is acknowledged, a Devil of
great power exists.{1a}It is written that the officials who
executed the Prophet Anoia were
manipulated by the Devil, and that
before that it brought Anoia many{1a}trials.{1a}The Devil's reason for being is simple.{1a}Without someone to defeat, there is no
way to show people how great God is.{1a}And the stronger the Devil to be
defeated, the more absolute God
becomes.{1a}Apply this to the 'New World' and
ourselves,{1a}and the more we Children of the Devil
hinder them, the more perfect God, that
is, the 'New World', becomes...{1a}Not a welcome hypothesis, but that is
how it comes out.{1a}Even our hindrance may already have
been part of their schedule...{1a}But we cannot turn back either...{1a}Everything favors them, but let us keep
trying, and not give up until their plan
shows a crack.{0c:040e}

of Asla Fael based on... That question is
now answered.{1a}For the Thirteen Saints who wrote the

strings.en:
{1c:10}'Purgatory' in the Scriptures lies
between Heaven and Hell,{1a}and is held to be the place where the
souls of the dead have their sins purged
by fire before entering Heaven.{1a}Incidentally, the 'Hell' of the early Anoian

greatest terror to the people of that
age.{1a}Even people of such technical skill as
theirs feared the 'Void'... One could see
it that way, could one not?{0c:040e}

strings.en:
{1c:12}In truth, the name 'Sea of Spirit' does
not appear in the Scriptures.{1a}No, not only the name. Of the seven
worlds God made, this one alone, next to
the 'Land of Origin', is given no
description whatsoever.{1a}The nearness of the Land of Origin and
the advancing fusion of the spirit world
and the material world surely play a part
as well,{1a}but because people's hearts hold no
clear image of this place, perhaps the
scenery differs with whoever goes
there.{1a}Ah... I said there was no description at
all, but there is a description of the
'Door of Light'.{1a}At the end of the Scriptures, in the
chapter of Revelation, it is written thus.{1a}'When the voices of the people crying
out for God swell, and a hateful monster
ruling vengeance and wrath stains the
temple of the Celestial Realm with{1a}blood, the second Prophet shall appear...{1a}And when the second Prophet opens the
door of light to the 'Land of Origin', the
age of man shall end,{1a}and the eternal age of God, the 'New
World', shall begin...'{1a}The 'Door of Light' must lie in the 'Sea
of Spirit', next to the 'Land of Origin'.
Then who is the second Prophet who
opens that 'Door of Light'...{1a}In any case, we can only go and see. I will
follow later.{0c:040e}

台風の目になっているようですね。{1a}悪魔の出現、天使の降臨、
終わることのない戦争が
教皇軍にとっては全て追い風に
作用しているようですが、{1a}魔法具の存在も、教皇軍躍進の
原動力の1つにあるようです。{1a}刻印を復活させない魔法操具など、
私達にしてみれば基本装備に
過ぎないのですが、{1a}弓や剣と違い特別な訓練がなくても
戦力になり得るので
数が揃えば充分脅威となるでしょう。{1a}ですが、この40年間にこの町で
発見された魔法具・魔法操具は
どんなに多く見積もっても
5千組程度のはず・・・{1a}なのに、壁新聞の記事を読むと、
数十万単位の魔法具が
存在するようにしか読めないのです。{1a}町の外では魔法具までもが
具現化しているのでしょうか・・・{1a}だとすれば、
外の戦乱はさらに苛烈なものに
なると覚悟しなければなりませんね。{1a}もちろん、
『新しい世界』が到来してしまえば
これもただの杞憂に
終わってしまいますが。{0c:040e}
strings.en:
{1c:12}Out in the world, the Pope's forces
seem to be the eye of the storm.{1a}The appearance of devils, the descent
of angels and endless war all seem to be
fair winds for the Papal Army,{1a}but the existence of Magic Tools seems
to be one of the driving forces behind
its rise as well.{1a}To us, a Spell Device with no restored
sigils is no more than basic equipment,{1a}but unlike bows or swords they make a
fighting force with no special training, so
in numbers they could be a real threat.{1a}Yet in these 40 years, the Magic Tools
and Spell Devices found in this town can
number no more than some five thousand
sets, however generously one counts...{1a}And yet the articles in the wall
newspaper can only be read as saying
Magic Tools exist by the hundreds of
thousands.{1a}Are even Magic Tools taking form
outside the town...{1a}If so, we must be prepared for the
fighting out there to grow fiercer still.{1a}Of course, if the 'New World' arrives,
this too will prove no more than a
needless worry.{0c:040e}
